Manifest.Name: 要不要进货 Inventory Category Stats
Manifest.Author: Oniisama
Manifest.Description:
在柜台电话下沿贴一张便签。点开后按游戏标签做物品分类统计：每行一个品类、颜色和件数，并记下赃物与违禁品。悬停高亮对应库存，点击锁定后不再跟着别的标签变。用来看品类记录和标签记录，决定要不要进货。
设置： 跳过上锁容器里的货：锁着的箱子和锁后的物品不计入分类，也不描边。默认开启。 跳过杂物堆：不把没法搬走的杂物算进库存。默认开启。 描边粗细：物品外框的像素粗细，1 到 6，默认最细一档。 库存刷新间隔（秒）：便签上的件数和描边按这个间隔重算，0.2 到 2 秒。 是否显示下列类型：赃物、违禁品和基础类型默认显示；细分类型和未归类默认不显示。
A sticky note sits under the counter phone. Open it for a tally by the game's own tags: each row shows a category, its color, and a count, and stolen goods and contraband are noted too. Hover a row to outline that stock; click to lock the highlight so it stays put when you look at another tag. Use it to read the category and tag records and decide whether to restock.
Settings: Skip goods inside locked containers: locked boxes and the items behind a lock are left out of the tally and the outline. On by default. Skip debris: piles you cannot move are not counted as stock. On by default. Outline thickness: pixel thickness of the item outline, from 1 to 6. Defaults to the thinnest. Stock refresh interval (seconds): how often the counts and outlines are recalculated, from 0.2 to 2. Show these types: stolen goods, contraband, and the main types are shown by default. Detail types and Uncategorized stay off.
